description: Hralsa wears an opaque deep navy floor-length gown with a low square neckline and naturally fitted bodice. Narrow gold woven geometric borders run along the shoulder edges, neckline, center front, elbow-length outer sleeves and hem. Ivory linen underlayers show at the forearms and skirt opening. A narrow patterned belt has paired round metal fastenings and long hanging ends. A navy fringed shawl drapes loosely around both forearms. A small round pendant and subtle earrings provide restrained jewelry. Brown leather shoes appear below the skirt. No headgear, armor or weapon appears.
